## Problem and result

Explain the learner/contributor problem and what changes. Link a related issue if applicable.

## Verification

List checks actually run and their results. Note anything untested. Include screenshots for UI changes.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not expose credentials or learner data.
- [ ] Content/model changes include source, license, and review context where applicable.
- [ ] Progress/identity changes preserve existing learners or include a deliberate migration.
- [ ] Documentation reflects any setup, privacy, download, or hosting changes.
